text:
Coconut Thai Curry Beef Broth Bowls 🥥🌶️ Comment ‘recipe’ and I’ll send it straight to your DMs.🫶

I’m a sucker for trying all the viral recipes.🤭 Can you tell?

This viral broth bowl has crispy caramelized beef, fluffy jasmine rice, and a rich coconut curry broth all piled into one big bowl.✨

Add some fresh cucumber, green onions, a squeeze of lime, and a spoonful of chili crunch and you have the coziest, umami-filled, broth bowl that I believe can practically heal you.😮‍💨
